cohort: Pregnant women visiting the OPD and labor rooms to give birth
finding: Meconium-stained liquor is linked to older mothers, earlier gestational ages, higher cesarean section rates, poorer Apgar scores, higher NICU admission rates, and adverse newborn outcomes.
mod_finding: Pregnancies complicated with meconium-stained liquor had a greater frequency of assisted vaginal delivery and cesarean birth.
